name: archiet-xray
description: Deterministic repo architecture maps: auth coverage, blast radius, readiness score, diagrams
long_description: X-Ray extracts the real architecture of any repo — every route with auth-guard status, ORM entities and relations, the module dependency graph with blast-radius hotspots, boundary risks (hardcoded secrets, raw SQL, tokens in localStorage), a deterministic 0-100 production-readiness score, and Mermaid architecture diagrams. No LLM anywhere in the pipeline, stdlib-only, zero network calls — your code never leaves your machine.

repo_path.title: Repository to analyze
repo_path.description: The local repository X-Ray maps for your AI agent. Code never leaves your machine.

tools.name: xray_scan
tools.description: Scan the repository and build the architecture model (routes, entities, tasks, module graph, findings).

tools.name: arch_summary
tools.description: Compact architecture summary: modules, route prefixes, domain entities, hotspots, visibility score.

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: What depends on a file/module (fan-in), what it depends on (fan-out), and the routes/entities it contains.

tools.name: boundary_findings
tools.description: Deterministic risk findings: hardcoded secrets, raw SQL, tokens in localStorage, routes without auth guards.

tools.name: production_readiness
tools.description: Deterministic 0-100 production-readiness score across 8 dimensions with evidence and top fixes.

tools.name: generate_diagrams
tools.description: Mermaid module graph, ER diagram, and HTTP route map extracted from the code, plus an HTML viewer.
